title: ITCZ to bring isolated rains, thunderstorms to Visayas

blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The Visayas will experience partly cloudy to cloudy skies with isolated rains or thunderstorms on Wednesday, September 30, due to effects of the Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ). In its daily forecast, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said flash floods or landslides might be possible during severe thunderstorms. The Negros Island Region, Zamboanga Peninsula, and Palawan, including Kalayaan Islands, will meanwhile see cloudy skies with rain showers and thunderstorms also due to the ITCZ.
